docs.title: ⚡ BlueHellStats Documentation
docs.text: Welcome to the official documentation for BlueHellStats, the premium statistics tracking, leaderboard visualization, in-world 3D podium, and automated seasonal tournament engine engineered exclusively for modern Paper 1.21+ Minecraft servers and networks.

docs.title: 🌟 Key Features
docs.text:
• ⚡ Ultra-Low Latency & Zero Tick Lag: Engineered from the ground up for massive player counts. All database queries, score updates, and leaderboard sorting run strictly in the background without affecting your server's 20.0 TPS.
  • 🗿 In-World 3D Podiums: Showcase your top players right in your spawn or lobby using vanilla ArmorStands, Citizens NPCs, or FancyNpcs with rotating floating billboards.
  • 🏆 Automated Seasons & Tournaments: Schedule monthly or custom seasons with automatic resets, reward queuing for winners, and an interactive Hall of Fame browser.
  • 🚀 Global & Tebex Stat Boosters: Trigger timed server-wide (all) or category-specific multipliers via /bhe booster with sponsor attribution, BossBar countdowns, and sound effects.
  • 🛡️ Built-In Anti-Farm Protection: Safeguard leaderboards with ignore-player-placed block tracking, PvP same-victim-cooldown-seconds, and ignore-same-ip alt-account filtering.
  • 🔌 Dynamic Custom Event Engine: Track custom actions from any 3rd-party plugin (custom items, bosses, skills, minigames) directly from stats.yml without writing a single line of Java code.
  • 🎨 Resource Pack & Customizable GUIs: Modern declarative YAML menus supporting ItemsAdder, Oraxen, Nexo, Base64 heads, <progress_bar> milestone bars, 1-click CLAIM_REWARDS, and anti-dupe security.
  • 🧩 Public Developer API: Integrate cleanly via BlueHellStatsAPI, PlayerStatIncrementEvent, and SeasonRolloverCompleteEvent.
  • 🧵 Folia & Paper Regionized Ready: Built-in PlatformScheduler routes async, global, entity, and region tasks automatically (folia-supported: true).
  • 🔔 Zero-Dependency Discord Webhooks: Send asynchronous JSON embeds on Season Rollover and Booster Activation without extra libraries.
  • 🌐 Network-Ready Storage: Native support for SQLite (single server) as well as MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL with connection pooling for multi-server BungeeCord and Velocity networks.
  • 📑 Extensive PlaceholderAPI Integration: Instantly show personal stats, rankings, boosters, and season countdowns on scoreboards, chat, and tablists with zero lag.

docs.title: 💡 Built for Production Servers
docs.text: BlueHellStats is crafted to give server owners peace of mind: 1. Uncompromising Performance: Player stat changes are batched safely in memory and saved asynchronously in the background. Disk and database operations will never freeze your main tick loop. 2. Rock-Solid Data Safety: Even during sudden disconnects or server restarts, all pending player stats are committed cleanly to storage so progress is never lost. 3. Hardened Exploitation Shields: Virtual menus enforce comprehensive anti-dupe checks that cancel illicit clicks, hotbar number swaps, off-hand swaps, and fast-click macro spam. 4. Seamless Multi-Server Scalability: Scale from a single survival server to a multi-proxy network with real-time leaderboard synchronization across all your server nodes.

docs.title: 🚀 Global & Stat-Specific Boosters
docs.text: Reward your community with timed Happy Hours or monetize global multipliers cleanly through Tebex and CraftingStore. BlueHellStats includes built-in support for both server-wide (all) and single-statistic boosters.

docs.title: 💡 Key Highlights
docs.text:
• Zero Configuration Required: Ready to trigger straight from the console or in-game.
  • Automatic Expiration: Boosters automatically expire once their scheduled duration ends.
  • Tebex / Webstore Friendly: Supports sponsor attribution ([sponsor]) so buyers are celebrated across the entire server.
  • Smart Precedence: When both a global booster (all) and a stat-specific booster (e.g., kills) are active simultaneously, BlueHellStats applies the highest active multiplier rather than compounding infinitely.

docs.title: Server-Wide Happy Hour (All Statistics)
docs.text:
Grants a 2.0x multiplier across every tracked stat for 30 minutes credited to Steve: 

bhe booster start all 2.0 30m {username}

docs.title: Category-Specific Booster
docs.text:
Grants a 1.5x multiplier strictly for diamonds_mined for 1 hour: 

bhe booster start diamonds_mined 1.5 1h {username}

docs.title: Managing Active Boosters
docs.text:
• /bhe booster list — View all running boosters, sponsors, and remaining countdowns.
  • /bhe booster stop <stat|all> — Cancel a specific or global booster early.
  • /bhe booster clear — Immediately clear all running boosters.

docs.title: 🎨 Live BossBar & Audio Feedback (config.yml)
docs.text:
Active boosters automatically display a synchronized Adventure BossBar countdown to online players and play an activation sound, configured cleanly in config.yml:

boosters:
  bossbar:
    enabled: true
    color: "YELLOW"
    overlay: "PROGRESS"
    title: "<gold><bold>⚡ %multiplier% BOOSTER</bold></gold> <gray>(%stat% • Sponsored by <yellow>%sponsor%</yellow>)</gray> <aqua>%remaining%</aqua>"

sounds:
  booster-start: "BLOCK_BEACON_ACTIVATE"

docs.title: 📑 Scoreboard & Chat Placeholders
docs.text:
Display live booster announcements on scoreboards, action bars, or holograms via PlaceholderAPI:

  • %bluehell_booster_active% — true if any booster is currently running.
  • %bluehell_booster_multiplier_kills% — Current effective multiplier (e.g. 2.0x or 1.0x).
  • %bluehell_booster_remaining_kills% — Time remaining until expiration (e.g. 29m 45s or None).
  • %bluehell_booster_sponsor_kills% — Name of the player or webstore sponsor (Steve or None).

docs.title: 🔌 Zero-Overhead Dynamic Custom Event Engine
docs.text: BlueHellStats features an event interception engine that allows you to hook and track events emitted by any 3rd-party plugin (such as custom turrets, custom enchants, slimefun items, custom bosses, or jobs) directly from your configuration, without needing custom addons or programming.

docs.title: 🚀 Configuration Syntax (stats.yml)
docs.text:
To track an external plugin's event, set event: CUSTOM and configure the custom_event_data section:

stats:
  turrets_placed:
    display-name: "<yellow>Turrets Placed</yellow>"
    event: CUSTOM
    increment: 1
    custom_event_data:
      event: "dt.ajneb97.api.TurretPlaceEvent"
      player_variable: "getPlayer()"
      variables_to_capture:
        - "%world%;getLocation().getWorld().getName()"
        - "%turret_type%;getTurretType()"
      conditions:
        - "%world% equals world"
        - "%turret_type% equals LASER"

docs.title: ⚙️ Configuration Properties
docs.text: Property Description Example event The full event class name provided by the 3rd-party plugin. "dt.ajneb97.api.TurretPlaceEvent" player_variable The method path returning the player responsible for the event. "getPlayer()" or "getEntity()" variables_to_capture List of placeholders and their getter method chains. "%world%;getLocation().getWorld().getName()" conditions Logic checks comparing captured variables before incrementing. "%world% equals world", "%level% >= 5"

docs.title: 🔍 How to Find Event Names for Any Plugin
docs.text:
Most plugin developers publish their API event names in their documentation or GitHub repositories.

  1. Check the plugin's documentation: Look for an "API" or "Developer" section (for example: com.sk89q.worldguard.protection.events.DisallowedPVPEvent).
  2. Identify the player getter: Typically getPlayer(), getEntity(), or getDamager().
  3. Capture contextual values: You can chain standard Java getter methods, such as getItem().getType().name() or getLocation().getWorld().getName().

docs.title: ⚡ Performance Guarantee
docs.text:
Tracking dynamic events in other plugins often causes severe lag spikes if implemented poorly.

BlueHellStats solves this completely: * Pre-Compiled at Startup: Method chains are resolved and compiled into high-speed executable handles during server startup and /bhe reload. * Zero Runtime Overhead: When events fire in game, conditions are checked at near-native compiled speed with zero memory allocation or CPU overhead. * Safe Fallbacks: If a configured plugin is not installed or the event class is not found, BlueHellStats logs a clean warning in console without crashing your server.

docs.title: 🎨 GUI Customization & Anti-Dupe Protection
docs.text: All user interfaces in BlueHellStats are declarative, customizable via YAML files inside plugins/BlueHellEssence/menus/, and built with enterprise-grade anti-dupe security.

docs.title: 🛡️ Anti-Dupe Security & Protection
docs.text:
Virtual menus in Minecraft can be susceptible to item duplication and ghost item glitches if poorly designed. BlueHellStats employs a comprehensive security shield:

  1. Strict Interaction Cancellation: All inventory clicks, drags, and item movements are strictly intercepted and cancelled before they can affect inventories.
  2. Hotbar Swap & Injection Shield: Number key swaps (1-9), shift-clicks, off-hand swaps (F), and double-clicks are completely blocked.
  3. Macro & Autoclicker Debouncing: An internal per-player debouncer prevents rapid autoclickers and packet flood race conditions during menu transitions.
  4. Tamper-Proof Action Metadata: Menu buttons store navigation actions in persistent item metadata, ensuring menus cannot be exploited by item renaming, anvil tampering, or custom resource packs.

docs.title: 1. Hub Menu (menus/hub.yml)
docs.text:
The main category selector opened via /top: 

title: "<dark_gray>Hall of Fame - Categories</dark_gray>"
rows: 4
items:
  diamonds_category:
    slot: 10
    material: DIAMOND
    action: OPEN_STAT:diamonds_mined
    name: "<aqua><bold>Diamonds Mined</bold></aqua>"
    lore:
      - "<gray>Your Score: <aqua><score_formatted></aqua> (<gold><rank></gold>)</gray>"
      - "<progress_bar> <gray>(<progress_percent>)</gray>"
      - "<yellow>▶ Click to open leaderboard</yellow>"
  claim_rewards:
    slot: 24
    material: CHEST_MINECART
    action: CLAIM_REWARDS
    name: "<green><bold>Claim Season Rewards</bold></green>"

docs.title: 3. Detailed Player Profile (menus/profile.yml)

Shows all statistics, scores, milestone progress, and network ranks for a specific player:

rows: 5

  • Interactive Navigation: Clicking any player head in /top <stat> opens their multi-stat profile.
  • Automatic Pagination: Automatically distributes categories across multiple pages if you configure more stats than available slots.

docs.title: 4. Milestone & Battle Pass Progress Track (menus/milestones.yml)
docs.text: Displays a horizontal tier progression track (/top pass or /top progress <stat>) with 3 visual states (completed, in_progress, locked) and <description> lines from stats.yml: * OPEN_MILESTONES:<stat_id> — Opens the visual tier roadmap for <stat_id> (used on the Battle Pass card in menus/hub.yml and the Milestone Tiers button in menus/top.yml). * OPEN_MILESTONES (without payload) — Opens the milestone track for the currently viewed leaderboard stat.

docs.title: 🎭 Custom Resource Packs & Head Textures
docs.text:
BlueHellStats seamlessly integrates with popular custom item and resource-pack plugins without requiring any manual setup or hard dependencies:

Format Example Description ItemsAdder itemsadder:bluehell:gold_trophy (or ia:...) Resolves a custom ItemsAdder stack directly in any menu slot. Oraxen oraxen:emerald_crown (or oxn:...) Resolves a custom Oraxen item directly in any menu slot. Nexo nexo:ruby_badge Resolves a custom Nexo item directly in any menu slot. Base64 Heads basehead-<base64> (or head:<base64>) Renders custom textured player heads without needing online player profiles. CustomModelData custom-model-data: 2025 Supported on static buttons as well as dynamic templates (entry, player_card, and stat_entry).

docs.title: Example Custom-Textured Item
docs.text:
items:
  hall_of_fame_btn:
    slot: 22
    material: "itemsadder:server_ui:trophy_gold"
    custom-model-data: 1050
    action: OPEN_HOF
    name: "<gold><bold>Hall of Fame</bold></gold>"
    lore:
      - "<gray>Inspect past tournament winners!</gray>"

docs.title: 📊 Visual Progress Bars & GUI Actions
docs.text:
Any statistic card in menus/hub.yml, menus/top.yml (my_stats), or menus/profile.yml (stat_entry) supports dynamic milestone progress placeholders:

  • <progress_bar> — Renders a 10-segment MiniMessage progress bar (■■■■■□□□□□) toward the next milestone.
  • <progress_percent> — Renders percentage progress (e.g. 50% or 100%).
  • <next_milestone> — Displays the next threshold value formatted with commas (or MAX once all milestones are unlocked).

docs.title: Supported Button action Values
docs.text:
• OPEN_STAT:<stat_id> — Opens the Top 10 leaderboard menu for <stat_id>.
  • OPEN_PROFILE / PLAYER_STATS — Opens the player's profile grid.
  • OPEN_HOF — Opens the Seasonal Hall of Fame browser.
  • CLAIM_REWARDS — Closes the menu and claims all pending seasonal Top-3 rewards with configured sound feedback (sounds.reward-claim in config.yml).
  • COMMAND:<cmd> — Runs <cmd> as the clicking player (%player% supported).
  • BACK, PREVIOUS_PAGE, NEXT_PAGE, CLOSE — Built-in navigation controls (sounds.gui-click & sounds.gui-page-turn in config.yml).

docs.title: 🗿 In-World 3D Podiums Guide
docs.text: BlueHellStats allows you to spawn physical 3D podium statues directly in the Minecraft world to honor top contenders in real time.

docs.title: 🎨 Supported Podium Providers
docs.text:
Configure the podium type per entry in podiums.yml:

podiums:
  diamonds_mined_1:
    stat: "diamonds_mined"
    rank: 1
    type: FANCY_NPCS # Options: ARMOR_STAND, CITIZENS, FANCY_NPCS
    world: "world"
    x: 100.5
    y: 65.0
    z: -200.5
    yaw: 180.0
    pitch: 0.0

docs.title: 1. ARMOR_STAND (Native Paper 1.21+)
docs.text:
• Dependencies: None! Works out of the box on vanilla Paper servers.
  • Features: Spawns an ArmorStand wearing the real top player's skin skull (retrieved automatically from the Mojang API), tier-themed armor (Gold for 1st, Iron for 2nd, Chainmail for 3rd), and a hand-held trophy item.
  • Protection: Equipment and armor stands are marked invulnerable and tamper-proof.

docs.title: 2. CITIZENS (Citizens 2)
docs.text:
• Dependencies: Citizens 2.
  • Features: Spawns a full NPC player model dynamically applying the top player's skin. Supports Citizens traits, equipment, and poses.

docs.title: 3. FANCY_NPCS (FancyNpcs 2.10+ & 2.12+)
docs.text:
• Dependencies: FancyNpcs.
  • Features: Lightweight packet-based player NPCs with zero server entity overhead.
  • Compatibility: Fully compatible out of the box with Paper 1.21 and 1.21.1+.

docs.title: 🧘 Managing Poses with FancyNpcs
docs.text:
FancyNpcs allows you to customize the pose of any podium NPC in game:

/npc attribute bhe_podium_<stat>_<rank> set pose <pose>

Supported poses for Player NPCs: * standing (Default upright posture) * crouching (Sneaking posture) * sleeping (Horizontal sleeping posture) * swimming (Horizontal swimming posture) * sitting (Mounted sitting posture)

Example: 

/npc attribute bhe_podium_diamonds_mined_1 set pose crouching

docs.title: 🪧 Paper 1.21 TextDisplay Billboards
docs.text:
All podium providers spawn an overhead floating TextDisplay entity at $Y + 2.15$: * Billboard mode is set to CENTER, ensuring the text smoothly rotates to face approaching players from any angle. * Text displays the placement medal, player name, and formatted score: 

[#1] Steve
1,450 Diamonds Mined

docs.title: 🖱️ Interactive Click Routing
docs.text: When players punch or right-click any podium statue: * Players are automatically routed directly to /top <stat> for that podium's category. * Includes fast-click spam protection to ensure smooth client performance.

docs.title: 🏆 Seasons & Tournaments Engine
docs.text: BlueHellStats includes a seasonal competition engine that automates tournament schedules, historical archiving, and safe reward distribution.

docs.title: ⚙️ Season Configuration (seasons.yml)
docs.text:
season:
  enabled: true
  auto-rollover: true
  rollover-interval-days: 30
  barrier-delay-ms: 1000 # Synchronization delay across multi-server networks

current-season:
  id: 1
  name: "Season 1 - Genesis"
  start-time: "2026-11-01T00:00:00Z"
  end-time: "2026-11-30T23:59:59Z"

rewards:
  claim-on-join: true
  fallback-podium-rewards:
    1:
      - "eco give %player% 50000"
      - "broadcast <gold>[SEASON]</gold> <yellow>%player%</yellow> conquered Season #%season%!"
    2:
      - "eco give %player% 25000"
    3:
      - "eco give %player% 10000"

docs.title: 🔒 Safe Tournament Rollovers
docs.text:
When a season expires (either automatically based on duration or manually via /season rollover):

  1. Snapshot & Lock: The server takes a synchronized snapshot of all leaderboard standings to ensure rankings are captured accurately without mid-reset race conditions.
  2. Historical Archiving & Reward Distribution: Top winners for every active category are permanently archived in the Hall of Fame. Winning reward commands are queued safely for offline and online players.
  3. Season Activation & Reset: The new season starts automatically with fresh leaderboards, while past season achievements remain permanently viewable in the Hall of Fame.

docs.title: 🎁 Reward Delivery & Hall of Fame Browser
docs.text:
• Offline Reward Safety: If a player is offline when the season ends, their rewards remain safely queued until their next login (claim-on-join: true) or until they execute /season claim.
  • Interactive Hall of Fame (/halloffame): Players can open an interactive GUI at any time to browse past tournament seasons, inspect podium winners, and see final scores.

docs.title: 📊 Statistics Configuration (stats.yml)
docs.text: BlueHellStats allows you to declare unlimited dynamic statistics with granular condition filtering, permission multipliers, milestone rewards, and seasonal prizes.

docs.title: 🛠️ YAML Structure & Options
docs.text:
stats:
  <stat_id>:
    display-name: "<color>Display Name</color>"
    event: <EVENT_TYPE>
    increment: 1
    cooldown-ms: 0
    conditions:
      materials: [DIAMOND_ORE, DEEPSLATE_DIAMOND_ORE]
      entities: [PLAYER, ZOMBIE]
      game-modes: [SURVIVAL]
      ignore-silk-touch: true
      ignore-player-placed: true # Anti-farm: ignore blocks placed by players
      same-victim-cooldown-seconds: 300 # Anti-farm (PvP): cooldown before same victim counts again
      ignore-same-ip: true # Anti-farm (PvP): block kill farming between shared-IP alts
      world-mode: WHITELIST # Options: WHITELIST or BLACKLIST
      worlds: [world, world_nether]
      regions: [arena_pvp] # WorldGuard region IDs
    multipliers:
      "bluehell.multiplier.vip": 2.0
      "bluehell.multiplier.mvp": 3.0
    milestones:
      - threshold: 100
        message: "<green>You reached 100 diamonds!</green>"
        broadcast: "<gold><player> reached 100 diamonds!</gold>"
        title: "<gold><bold>MILESTONE UNLOCKED!</bold></gold>"
        subtitle: "<yellow>100 Diamonds Mined</yellow>"
        sound: "UI_TOAST_CHALLENGE_COMPLETE"
        commands:
          - "give %player% diamond 5"
    season-rewards:
      1:
        - "eco give %player% 50000"
        - "broadcast <gold>[SEASON]</gold> <yellow>%player%</yellow> won Top 1!"
      2:
        - "eco give %player% 25000"
      3:
        - "eco give %player% 10000"

docs.title: 🎯 Supported Native Event Types
docs.text: Event Type Bukkit Trigger Event Supported Condition Filters BLOCK_BREAK BlockBreakEvent materials, ignore-silk-touch, ignore-player-placed, game-modes, worlds, regions BLOCK_PLACE BlockPlaceEvent materials, game-modes, worlds, regions ENTITY_KILL EntityDeathEvent entities (e.g. PLAYER, ENDER_DRAGON), same-victim-cooldown-seconds, ignore-same-ip, game-modes, worlds, regions ITEM_CRAFT CraftItemEvent materials, game-modes, worlds ITEM_CONSUME PlayerItemConsumeEvent materials, game-modes, worlds PLAYER_FISH PlayerFishEvent materials (caught item), game-modes, worlds CUSTOM Any Bukkit Event See Dynamic Custom Events for details

docs.title: 🧩 Composite Boolean Requirements
docs.text:
Define cross-stat requirements that can be evaluated dynamically in PlaceholderAPI (%bluehell_req_<id>%):

requirements:
  nether_champion:
    pvp_kills: 50
    diamonds_mined: 500
    blaze_kills: 100
When a player reaches or exceeds all threshold values, %bluehell_req_nether_champion% returns true.

docs.title: ⚙️ Database Configuration
docs.text: BlueHellStats provides a high-performance, asynchronous database engine powered by enterprise-grade HikariCP connection pooling and automatic schema management.

docs.title: 🗄️ Supported Database Engines
docs.text: Configure your storage engine in plugins/BlueHellEssence/config.yml:

docs.title: 1. SQLite (Default — Single Server / Local)
docs.text:
Ideal for single-server setups, survival servers, or testing environments. Requires zero setup or external services.

locale: "en"

database:
  type: SQLITE
  sqlite:
    file: "bluehell.db"

docs.title: 2. MySQL / MariaDB (Multi-Server Network / Bungee / Velocity)
docs.text:
Ideal for networks hosted across multiple nodes, shared dedicated servers, or managed via phpMyAdmin/Pterodactyl.

locale: "en"

database:
  type: MYSQL # or MARIADB
  mysql:
    host: "127.0.0.1"
    port: 3306
    database: "network_stats"
    username: "minecraft"
    password: "your_strong_password"
    ssl: false

sync:
  server-id: "" # Leave empty to auto-generate a unique server ID per node
  poll-interval-ms: 1000
  flush-interval-seconds: 20
  leaderboard-refresh-seconds: 60
  leaderboard-top-size: 10

docs.title: 3. PostgreSQL (Enterprise High-Performance)
docs.text:
Recommended for massive network scales requiring ultra-low latency, robust connection pooling, and heavy concurrent player traffic.

locale: "en"

database:
  type: POSTGRESQL
  postgresql:
    host: "10.0.0.5"
    port: 5432
    database: "network_stats"
    username: "postgres_user"
    password: "your_strong_password"
    ssl: false

docs.title: ⚡ Performance & Data Safety Guarantees
docs.text:
To ensure that your server runs smoothly with consistent 20.0 TPS even during high player activity:

  • Asynchronous Execution: Database operations, connection handshakes, and queries never run on your main server thread. Your gameplay and tick rates remain completely unaffected.
  • Smart Memory Caching: Stat increments are tracked instantly in memory and batched before saving, minimizing database disk writes and network load.
  • Zero Stat Loss on Disconnect: Whenever a player leaves the server, any uncommitted progress is immediately committed to storage in the background.
  • Safe Server Shutdowns: When the server stops or restarts, BlueHellStats ensures all pending stat saves are safely finalized before releasing database connections.

docs.title: 🚀 Quick Start Guide
docs.text: This guide walks you through installing and configuring BlueHellStats on your Paper 1.21+ server.

docs.title: 📋 Requirements
docs.text:
• Server Platform: Paper, Purpur, or Folia (folia-supported: true) running Minecraft 1.21 or 1.21.1+.
  • Java Runtime: Java 21 or newer (OpenJDK / Temurin 21 recommended).
  • Optional Integrations:
  • PlaceholderAPI (for chat, scoreboard, and tablist placeholders)
  • Citizens or FancyNpcs (for in-world 3D player podium NPCs)
  • DecentHolograms (for floating spawn leaderboard holograms)
  • WorldGuard (for region-specific stat tracking like PvP arenas)
  • Vault (for economy commands in seasonal rewards and milestones)

docs.title: 📦 Installation
docs.text:
1. Deploy: Place the downloaded .jar file into your server's plugins/ directory.
  2. Start Server: Start your server to generate the default configuration files: 
    plugins/BlueHellEssence/
├── config.yml
├── seasons.yml
├── stats.yml
├── podiums.yml
├── messages/
│   ├── messages_en.yml
│   └── messages_es.yml
└── menus/
    ├── hub.yml
    ├── top.yml
    └── profile.yml
  3. Storage Setup: By default, BlueHellStats uses high-speed SQLite (bluehell.db), requiring zero initial configuration. For multi-server proxy networks, see Database Configuration.
  4. Live Reload: Modify your YAML files and run /bhe reload to apply updates instantly without restarting your server.

docs.title: ⌨️ Commands & Permissions Reference
docs.text: All commands support tab-completion, permission checks, and localization messages.

docs.title: 👥 Player Commands
docs.text: Command Permission Description /top bluehell.top Opens the main categories leaderboard hub (menus/hub.yml). /top <stat> bluehell.top Directly opens the leaderboard for a specific category (menus/top.yml). /top progress [stat] (aliases /top pass, /top milestones) bluehell.top Opens the visual milestone / Battle Pass progression track (menus/milestones.yml). /top profile [player] bluehell.profile Opens the multi-stat detail profile GUI for yourself or another player. /halloffame (alias /hof) bluehell.hof Opens the historical browser of past seasons and podium winners. /season info bluehell.season.info View active season duration and remaining time. /season claim bluehell.season.claim Manually claim pending seasonal rewards.

docs.title: 🛡️ Administrator Commands (/bhe)
docs.text:
Master permission: bluehell.admin (granted to operators by default).

Command Description /bhe add <player> <stat> <amount> Increment a player's score by the given amount. /bhe set <player> <stat> <amount> Set a player's score to an exact number. /bhe reset <player> <stat> Reset a player's stat to 0. /bhe profile [player] View any player's multi-stat profile GUI as administrator. /bhe reload Hot-reload all configurations, menus, and stats without server reboot.

docs.title: 🗿 Podium Sub-commands (/bhe podium)
docs.text: Sub-command Description /bhe podium create <stat> <1\|2\|3> [id] Spawn a 3D in-world podium statue at your exact location and yaw. /bhe podium remove <id\|stat> Remove a specific podium statue by ID or all podiums of a stat. /bhe podium list List all active 3D podiums and coordinates. /bhe podium refresh [id] Force immediate visual re-render of podium statues and billboards.

docs.title: 🪧 Hologram Sub-commands (/bhe holo)
docs.text: Sub-command Description /bhe holo create <stat> [rows] [name] Spawn a DecentHolograms floating leaderboard at your position. /bhe holo remove <name\|stat> Remove a floating leaderboard hologram.

docs.title: 🚀 Booster Sub-commands (/bhe booster)
docs.text: Sub-command Description /bhe booster start <stat\|all> <multiplier> <duration> [sponsor] Activate a timed global or stat-specific multiplier (e.g. /bhe booster start all 2.0 1h Steve). /bhe booster stop <stat\|all> Stop an active stat-specific or global booster. /bhe booster clear Stop all currently running boosters. /bhe booster list List all active boosters with remaining time and sponsors.

docs.title: 🏆 Season Admin Commands (/season)
docs.text:
Permission: bluehell.season.admin

Command Description /season status Display active season details, start/end dates, and status. /season start <number> <name> [duration] Force start a new season (e.g. /season start 2 "Winter Cup" 30d). /season end Force terminate the active season. /season rollover [number] [name] [duration] Execute immediate season rollover and reward distribution. /season resetall confirm Master administrative reset back to Season #1 (wipes history).

docs.title: 🧩 Developer API
docs.text: Third-party plugins (custom gamemodes, guild systems, buffs, or Discord integrations) can interact with BlueHellStats through the official BlueHellStatsAPI facade and custom Bukkit events.

docs.title: 🔌 Accessing the API
docs.text:
Add BlueHellEssence to your plugin.yml (depend or softdepend), then retrieve the active API instance either directly or via Bukkit's ServicesManager:

import com.dev.bluehell.api.BlueHellStatsAPI;
import org.bukkit.Bukkit;

if (BlueHellStatsAPI.isAvailable()) {
    BlueHellStatsAPI api = BlueHellStatsAPI.getInstance();
    long kills = api.getStat(player.getUniqueId(), "kills");
}

Or via ServicesManager: 

var registration = Bukkit.getServicesManager().getRegistration(BlueHellStatsAPI.class);
if (registration != null) {
    BlueHellStatsAPI api = registration.getProvider();
}

docs.title: ⚙️ Common API Operations
docs.text:
// Read cached stat synchronously for online players
long blocks = api.getStat(player.getUniqueId(), "diamonds_mined");

// Modify stats safely (queued automatically for persistence)
api.addStat(player.getUniqueId(), "kills", 5L);

// Activate a 2x global booster for 30 minutes
api.activateBooster("all", 2.0, Duration.ofMinutes(30), "GuildEvent");

// Query the current active season and effective booster multiplier
api.getActiveSeason().ifPresent(season -> {
    String name = season.name();
});
double multiplier = api.getEffectiveBoosterMultiplier("kills");

docs.title: PlayerStatIncrementEvent (Cancellable)
docs.text:
Fired before a player's statistic is incremented. You can cancel tracking under custom conditions or adjust the final increment amount (for example, guild perks or custom boosters):

@EventHandler
public void onStatIncrement(PlayerStatIncrementEvent event) {
    if (event.getStatId().equals("kills") && hasCustomPerk(event.getPlayer())) {
        event.setIncrementAmount(event.getIncrementAmount() * 2);
    }
}

docs.title: SeasonRolloverCompleteEvent (Async)
docs.text:
Fired asynchronously whenever a season rollover completes successfully, providing direct access to archived podium winners and reward queue totals:

@EventHandler
public void onSeasonRollover(SeasonRolloverCompleteEvent event) {
    int finishedSeason = event.getArchivedSeasonId();
    int newSeason = event.getNewSeasonId();
    List<PodiumEntry> winners = event.getPodiums();
}

docs.title: ❓ Frequently Asked Questions & Troubleshooting
docs.text: Find answers to common questions and troubleshooting advice for BlueHellStats.

docs.title: Will BlueHellStats cause lag on high player-count servers?
docs.text: No. BlueHellStats is built specifically for high-scale production networks: * All database interactions (queries, updates, and schema migrations) execute asynchronously in the background. * Player stat modifications are accumulated in memory and periodically saved in batches, minimizing disk I/O. * Leaderboard sorting and placeholder evaluations operate on pre-cached data, guaranteeing $O(1)$ instant lookups without blocking the server's main tick loop.

docs.title: How do I sync statistics across my network?
docs.text:
1. Open config.yml on each of your server instances.
  2. Set database.type to MYSQL, MARIADB, or POSTGRESQL.
  3. Provide the connection credentials for your shared database.
  4. Leave sync.server-id empty so each server generates its own unique ID, or give each server a friendly name (e.g., survival-1, lifesteal-1).
  5. All connected servers will sync player data and update leaderboards automatically.

docs.title: Which podium provider should I use?
docs.text:
• ARMOR_STAND: Best if you want zero external dependencies. Works directly on vanilla Paper servers with custom player heads and tier armor.
  • FANCY_NPCS: Recommended for optimal performance on large servers. Uses packet-based rendering with zero server-side entity overhead and supports custom poses (sitting, crouching, etc.).
  • CITIZENS: Best if your server already utilizes Citizens and you want full NPC trait integration.

docs.title: How do I remove or move an existing podium?
docs.text:
To remove a podium: 

/bhe podium remove <id|stat>
To reposition, simply stand at the new coordinates and execute: 
/bhe podium create <stat> <rank>

docs.title: Can I track custom events from plugins without coding?
docs.text: Yes! Using the Dynamic Custom Event Engine in stats.yml, you only need the event class name and getter methods from the plugin's documentation. BlueHellStats hooks the event automatically at startup without requiring custom code or recompilation.

docs.title: What happens if a player is offline when a season ends?
docs.text: Pending rewards are safely queued in storage. When the winning player logs into the server, the queued rewards and commands are automatically executed (claim-on-join: true), or the player can run /season claim.

docs.title: My placeholders are displaying N/A or empty values
docs.text:
• Make sure PlaceholderAPI is installed on your server.
  • If testing a new statistic, ensure the player has triggered the stat at least once so their profile is registered.
  • Check your stats.yml to verify that the stat ID matches the placeholder query (e.g. %bluehell_stat_diamonds_mined%).

docs.title: Database connection fails on startup
docs.text:
• Verify that your MySQL / MariaDB / PostgreSQL server is accessible from your Minecraft server host.
  • Check that the user has CREATE, SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE privileges on the target database.
  • Ensure firewall rules permit traffic on the configured port (default 3306 for MySQL, 5432 for PostgreSQL).

docs.title: The podium NPC isn't wearing the top player's skin
docs.text: • Skins are fetched asynchronously from the Mojang API. On newly created podiums or servers in offline mode, ensure the server has an active internet connection to contact Mojang skin servers.

docs.title: 📑 PlaceholderAPI Reference
docs.text:
BlueHellStats provides a full expansion registered with PlaceholderAPI under the %bluehell_...% namespace.

All placeholders read directly from concurrency-safe RAM caches ($O(1)$) and never execute blocking queries on the main server thread.

docs.title: 📊 Player & Stat Placeholders
docs.text: Placeholder Description Output Example %bluehell_stat_<stat_id>% Raw integer stat value of the player. 1450 %bluehell_stat_formatted_<stat_id>% Comma-formatted score with thousands separators. 1,450 %bluehell_rank_<stat_id>% Player's placement in the leaderboard (or N/A). #3 %bluehell_has_<stat_id>_<min_score>% Boolean check whether player's score is $\ge$ minimum. true or false %bluehell_req_<requirement_id>% Boolean check against composite multi-stat requirement. true or false

docs.title: 🏆 Leaderboard Position Placeholders
docs.text: Placeholder Description Output Example %bluehell_top_<stat_id>_<pos>_name% Player name at leaderboard placement <pos>. Steve %bluehell_top_<stat_id>_<pos>_value% Raw score of player at placement <pos>. 500 %bluehell_top_<stat_id>_<pos>_value_formatted% Comma-formatted score at placement <pos>. 500

docs.title: 🗓️ Season & Tournament Placeholders
docs.text: Placeholder Description Output Example %bluehell_season_current_id% Numerical ID of the active season. 1 %bluehell_season_current_name% Display name of the active season. Season 1 - Genesis %bluehell_season_time_remaining% Formatted countdown until season ends. 14d 05h 22m %bluehell_history_<season>_<stat>_<rank>_name% Winner name of past season podium placement. Alex %bluehell_history_<season>_<stat>_<rank>_score% Final score of past season podium placement. 2,500 %bluehell_history_<season>_<stat>_<rank>_score_formatted% Formatted final score of past season podium placement. 2,500

docs.title: 🚀 Active Booster Placeholders
docs.text: Placeholder Description Output Example %bluehell_booster_active% Whether any global or stat booster is currently running. true or false %bluehell_booster_multiplier_<stat_id>% Current effective multiplier applying to <stat_id>. 2.0x %bluehell_booster_remaining_<stat_id>% Remaining duration of the governing booster (or None). 29m 14s %bluehell_booster_sponsor_<stat_id>% Sponsor name attached to the governing booster (or None). Steve
